bio.text: Billy Beasley, a Democrat, has represented District 28 in the Alabama State Senate since November 3, 2010, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.
Beasley served as state Senate minority leader from 2017 to 2019.

According to Ballotpedia, he was born on March 19, 1940, and his professional experience includes serving as president of Pratts Station LLC and operating Clayton Drug Company, Clio Drug Company and Louisville Drug Store.
